items.title: AWS Network Firewall proxy and native NAT Gateway integration
items.summary: With this launch you can use your AWS Network Firewall to filter HTTP and HTTPS traffic as an explicit proxy, inspect all other traffic as a routed firewall, and centralize egress from overlapping and non-overlapping source VPC through a NAT Gateway that Network Firewall manages for you. In August 2026, we re-introduced Network Firewall proxy […]
items.creator: Tom Adamski

items.title: Fast failover with Amazon Route 53 Private Endpoint Health Checks
items.summary: Amazon Route 53 Private Endpoint Health Checks bring native, fast DNS failover to private endpoints inside your VPC, without a custom CloudWatch and Lambda control loop. Learn how the feature works, how to set up a private health check and failover routing step by step, and the private-only resilience patterns it unlocks.
items.creator: Prabhakar Varadarajan
